This week, after months of preparation, our school community is thrilled to welcome teachers and students from one of our partner schools in Dunkirk, France, as part of our Erasmus plus programme! Our visitors, along with their hosting students, will enjoy all that our school has to offer through a week of exciting activities inspired by three of our project values — drawn from the Olympic spirit — Determination, Justice, and Participation. A special thank you to today’s guest speaker, John Lync
